ab.h2: Protecting lives. Empowering safety and the environment.
ab.p: RIM-HSE — Réseau d'Ingénierie Mauritanien pour la Santé, la Sécurité et l'Environnement — is a Mauritanian-owned HSE consultancy and training company, established in 2017 and headquartered in Nouakchott. We bridge the gap between international safety standards and local operational requirements, helping clients mitigate risk, ensure compliance, and prioritise their most valuable asset: their people.
ab.mp: To deliver high-quality HSE training, consulting, and safety solutions that help businesses meet international standards, reduce risks, and build a sustainable culture of safety.
ab.vp: To be the trusted leader in health, safety, and environmental excellence across Mauritania and West Africa — empowering organizations to protect lives, property, and the planet.

v.1p: We uphold the highest ethical standards in everything we do, ensuring trust and transparency with our clients and partners.
v.2p: We believe in protecting people and the environment by promoting safe work practices and regulatory compliance.
v.3p: We work hand-in-hand with clients, regulators, and stakeholders to achieve shared goals in HSE performance.
v.4p: We embrace technology and best practices to deliver effective, forward-thinking HSE solutions.

cl.h2: Trusted across sectors, with consistently positive feedback.
cl.p: RIM-HSE has proudly partnered with organizations across telecommunications, mining, agriculture, and oil & gas to deliver expert HSE training, audits, and consulting services.
cl.nt: Join the growing list of Mauritanian and international organisations that rely on RIM-HSE for training, audits, and compliance support. References and client case details are available on request —
